@@ -948,6 +948,14 @@ class Console:
             # return False for Jupyter, which may have FORCE_COLOR set
             return False
 
+        # TTY_COMPATIBLE env var overrides terminal detection:
+        # "0" forces non-terminal, "1" forces terminal.
+        tty_compatible = self._environ.get("TTY_COMPATIBLE", "")
+        if tty_compatible == "0":
+            return False
+        if tty_compatible == "1":
+            return True
+
         # If FORCE_COLOR env var has any value at all, we assume a terminal.
